change: Add private assistant-conversation worker lifecycle beside the existing inventory worker; include its abort/drain in graceful shutdown. Existing generic queue and node recovery remain unchanged.
scope: Worker role only, both ENABLE_ASSISTANT_CONVERSATION_WRITES and ENABLE_ASSISTANT_CONVERSATION_WORKER must be exactly true. No scheduling, seeding, generic ai_jobs registration, automatic unknown-stage retry or production activation.
privacy: Discovery reads bounded identity hints only; each claim, heartbeat, dispatch and publication reacquires current membership/resource authority. Logs contain fixed outcome codes, not conversation content.
execution: Route/reply calls run outside SQL transactions, after exact runtime pins and durable lease-bound dispatch checkpoint. Ready results recover without paying for their completed stage again.
verification: Frozen candidate test/type/lint/bundle evidence is recorded by the separate P5-A2 integration batch. This hash review alone is not runtime or release acceptance.
